text:
Alex: FYI the office stapler on floor C has been elevated to legendary status after yesterday's all-hands. People are calling it the "Stapler of Destiny" :crown:
Priya: I brought a tiny party crown and left it next to the printer. No shame. :tada:
Bean: Wait, are we officially naming it? There are rules for naming artifacts. We need a coronation, a scribe, and possibly a tiny throne. :scroll:
Kai: I nominate a naming vote. Options: Sir Staples, The Great Clamp, Lady Bindwell, or Keep as "Stapler of Destiny". React with :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote.
Alex: Also we should pick a steward who is responsible when it goes missing. Last time it disappeared for three days and showed up in sales. Noted trauma.
Priya: Steward duties: keep staples stocked, perform monthly polishing, and deny lending to interns after 3pm. Agree? :ok_hand:
Bean: I will be the scribe and write the proclamation. Also propose we attach a tiny laminated note with rules.
Kai: OpsBot, can you make a poll for the name and set a reminder for coronation day next Thursday at 4pm? Add #random ping.
OpsBot: Poll created: "Name the Stapler" 14 votes allowed. Reminder set: Coronation Thursday 4:00pm. Channel: #random.
Priya: Also, who has a good joke for the oath? I came up with: "I, holder of the staples, vow to never jam in the face of adversity." :laughing:
Alex: Love it. My contribution: "May your staples always be long and your jams be few." :stapler:
Bean: Draft proclamation (working):
```
By decree of floor C and all witness in channel #random, the stapler formerly known as a humble binder shall henceforth be known as "%NAME%". It shall preside over invoices, memos, and the occasional origami. It shall be polishes thrice monthly and fed staples on demand. Any attempt to steal shall be met with passive-aggressive Slack messages and confiscation.
```
Priya: Can we get a tiny felt cape? I have red felt in my drawer. Also will grocery-send a tiny pompom crown if we need. :sparkles:
Kai: Bean, please swap %NAME% with the poll winner after voting closes. Also capture a photo during coronation so we can add to the office lore folder.
Alex: Whoever wins, I'm making a sticker. This is peak office culture 2k25.
Priya: Also adding a two-line rule: if you borrow, return within 24 hours or provide pastry as restitution.
Bean: Agreed. Putting pastry clause in proclamation.
OpsBot: Poll closed. Results: 1) Sir Staples (5 votes), 2) The Great Clamp (2 votes), 3) Lady Bindwell (1 vote), 4) Stapler of Destiny (3 votes). Winner: Sir Staples.
Alex: Sir Staples it is. Coronation details: Thursday 4pm at the printer. Dress code: optional silly hat. Bring tiny flags. :flag_us: :flag_gb:
Priya: I will bring the crown and a tiny ribbon. Bean will read the proclamation. Kai will be official photographer.
Bean: Ceremony script ready. Short and silly. Photo ops included. If anyone tries to steal the crown, we call HR (kidding... mostly). :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
Kai: I'll upload coronation pics and add to #random lore album. Also thinking of making a short GIF for the wiki page.
Alex: Final note: Whoever branded this moment is a hero. Long live Sir Staples. :crown: :sparkles:
Priya: Post-coronation afterparty at the kitchen. Cupcakes provided. No pastries were harmed in the making of this decree. :cupcake:
